steps.name: rh_validate
steps.title: Validate the re-homing (headends to add / drop, allocations)
steps.summary: spoke2: central-headend, west-headend -> east-headend, west-headend; add east-headend (fw-east port 5 <-> Gi2, Tunnel8 172.17.8.0/30); drop central-headend (Tunnel5); the spoke reboots for the new NIC

steps.name: rh_intent
steps.title: Intent + lab.conf: new links and tunnels, dropped ones removed

steps.name: rh_vm
steps.title: Spoke VM redefined with the new WAN link and rebooted
steps.summary: spoke2 redefined with the new WAN link, rebooted, RESTCONF up

steps.name: pki
steps.title: Certificates: enrol the routers with the lab CA (trustpoint, CA cert, router cert)
steps.summary: 5 router(s) hold a certificate from the lab CA

steps.name: firewalls
steps.title: VyOS firewalls rendered from Nautobot and pushed
steps.summary: fw-central: committed; fw-east: committed; fw-west: committed

steps.name: plan
steps.title: Terraform plan
steps.summary: Plan: 12 to add, 9 to change, 12 to destroy.

steps.name: rh_verify
steps.title: Verify: new tunnels READY + eBGP Established, dropped ones gone
